evidence: Publication identity US20110247417A1, application 13062032 and date 20111013 directly verified in native bibliography. All 13 canonical claims match native after allowed number removal, claim-text boundary spacing and whitespace normalization. Native, selected-source and both original XML digests independently match provenance.

GPFBVMRRPPOPPY1 is the clean earlier wording: alternatives “any one of the preceding claims”, reference numerals and claim 5 “consists of ... preferably a cross-linked polystyrene copolymer”. These materially differ from native and were not ignored. GPFAIYRMPPOPPY1 is explicitly headed “AMENDMENT TO THE CLAIMS” / “Replace the claims with the following rewritten listing.” Visually reviewed all three marked PDF pages (printed 3–5), independently distinguishing strikeout from insertion; garbled marked XML/OCR is corroboration only and was not repaired into source text.

Marked PDF page 1 explicitly strikes claim 3/4 alternatives and inserts claim 1; page 2 does so for 5/6/8/9/10 and inserts claim 2 for 7; page 3 inserts claim 1 for 11/12/13. Claim 2 already names claim 1. Selected natural family therefore has independent method 1; 2–6 and 8–12 refer to 1; 7 refers to 2; device 13 expressly carries out method 1. This is source-reference family membership, without a legal determination of formal dependent-claim status.

PDF page 2 changes claim 5 “consists of” to “comprises” and deletes “preferably a cross-linked polystyrene copolymer”. Across pages 1–3 reference numerals and “characterized in that” are struck, “wherein” inserted; page 1 deletes “the” before sound velocity in claim 1 and page 2 deletes “the” before travel time in claim 7. Surviving substantive wording of all selected 1–13 agrees with native. Dependency changes and deleted polymer language thus have direct version evidence.

Full matching office action separately lists informal claim objections, then actual 112(b)/pre-AIA second-paragraph rejection of 1–13. Individual selected associations are 1/13 reflected ultrasound, associated signals, ultrasound and spaced transducers; 6 “the latter is uncoupled”; 7 “the leading body’s coupling surface”; 10 “the signals”; 11 “the outermost transducers”; 12 “the received pulse echo”. Native contains each phrase in the same numbered claim, allowing only curly/straight apostrophe presentation in claim 7. Claims 2/3/4/5/8/9 are blanket-scope/family context; no individual antecedent grounds are invented.
